doc: A store: its listings filtered, sorted and searched as the agent says so, products compared side by side, an item opened and its options picked, and the cart filled once the visitor said yes. The page writes the performers (where the filters are, how the cart opens); the kit fixes what each move is and how it reports.

args.name: facet
args.doc: The filter as the listing names it: Tamaño, Color.

args.name: value
args.doc: One option as the listing writes it, or several joined by commas.

args.name: path
args.doc: The listing's path, when it is not the one in front; it is opened first.

moves.say: {filter: Facet | Option} as you name a filter of the listing in front, one per sentence; {filter: Facet | Option, Option} for several options of one filter.
moves.doc: Apply one filter of the listing in front, one option or several of it, with the listing's own control.

args.name: path
args.doc: The listing's path, when it is not the one in front; it is opened first.

moves.say: {sort: price_asc} as you say how the listing is ordered: price_asc, price_desc, relevance or newest.

args.name: query
args.doc: The words to type, in the store's language.

args.name: open_index
args.doc: Open the suggestion at this place, 0 for the first.

moves.doc: Type into the store's own search box at a human pace and let its suggestions open; open one when asked.

args.name: first
args.doc: A product card's place in the listing in front, 1 for the first, as the listing slice orders its items (a numeral, "2", is read as 2).

moves.say: {compare: 1 | 3} as you set products of the listing side by side, by their place in it, two to four.
moves.doc: Ring the named cards of the listing in front side by side, each in its own ring, after scrolling the first into view; a page that can lay them out together may. Nothing on the page changes. Refuses a place the listing does not show, with the places it does.

args.name: path
args.doc: The item's path on the store.

args.name: option
args.doc: The product's option as its page names it: Talla, Tamaño, Peso, Color.

args.name: value
args.doc: One value of it as the page writes it: King, 1 kg.

moves.say: {variant: Option | Value} as you pick an option of the product in front, such as its size or weight.
moves.doc: Pick one value of an option of the product in front (size, weight, color) with the page's own control, so its price and stock follow. Never adds it to the cart. Refuses a value the page does not offer, with those it does.

args.name: path
args.doc: The item's path; it is opened first when it is not in front.

moves.doc: Add an item to the cart, once the visitor said yes. Never the checkout.
Set how many of a cart line they have, or take it out, once the visitor said yes. Never the checkout.

moves.say: {cart} as you point them to their cart; it opens.
moves.doc: Open the cart's drawer or page, or close it. As a cue, {cart} opens it; closing is a tool's.

slices.doc: the listing in front: its title, how many it shows, the filters on and offered, the order, the first items
what is in their cart: each line, how many, the subtotal

fields.name: free_shipping_left
fields.doc: What is left to spend for free shipping, when the store says.
